story_fr: Exelon a enregistré un bénéfice d'exploitation ajusté de 0,91 $ par action au premier trimestre 2026, confirmant ses prévisions.
story_en: Exelon reported adjusted operating earnings of $0.91 per share for Q1 2026, affirming its guidance.
quote: We delivered first quarter 2026 adjusted operating earnings of $0.91 per share

story_fr: Toutes les filiales d’Exelon ont atteint le premier quartile de performance en fiabilité, ComEd se classant dans le décile supérieur.
story_en: All Exelon utilities achieved top‑quartile reliability performance, with ComEd in the top decile.
quote: All utilities sustained top quartile in reliability performance, with ComEd in top decile

story_fr: Exelon a versé 60 millions de dollars d’aide directe via son fonds de secours aux clients.
story_en: Exelon provided $60 million in direct assistance through its Customer Relief Fund.
quote: $60 million provided in direct assistance through the company’s Customer Relief Fund

story_fr: Exelon prévoit 41,7 milliards de dollars d’investissements en capital sur quatre ans pour renforcer le réseau.
story_en: Exelon projects $41.7 billion of capital expenditures over the next four years to strengthen the grid.
quote: Projecting $41.7 billion of capital expenditures over the next four years

story_fr: À la fin du premier trimestre 2026, Exelon a réalisé 43 % de ses financements de dette prévus et a tarifé 37 % de ses besoins en capitaux propres.
story_en: By the end of Q1 2026, Exelon completed 43% of planned debt financings and priced 37% of its equity needs.
quote: completed approximately 43% of planned debt financings, and priced approximately 37% of its $3.4 billion of equity needs
